question:
The sequence of folding a piece of paper and the manner in which the folded paper has been cut is shown in the following figures. How would this paper look when unfolded?

solution:
When we unfold the paper step by step we get:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b049f58dfcb97dd87d909fceebbb2b0d5301e53f5f3d08e0b6aa2cebc2ff35be.png] 

Now we compare the pattern obtained with the given options:

Option 1) 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad8bb3206f4b4d7c59380fea5d8c27989feb3dd5c3c0bbaef5da9436e1717dee.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f7674a9ef0daa6c21eab450f460211fdfc470682dc29ba88e3f589a6d79c8c4.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b09b81e79165d847c0a662cb7c36365fd435b00837e5b5dcd5cb5ed16dc121ad.png] Number of rings are less, so the pattern is incorrect.

Option 2) 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fe8cf0688254c90e862487fa51bcafddf5adcae3fbb0a2b794937a5662f1331.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f7674a9ef0daa6c21eab450f460211fdfc470682dc29ba88e3f589a6d79c8c4.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b09b81e79165d847c0a662cb7c36365fd435b00837e5b5dcd5cb5ed16dc121ad.png] Number of rings are less & there is no symmetry, so the pattern is incorrect.

Option 3) 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b09b81e79165d847c0a662cb7c36365fd435b00837e5b5dcd5cb5ed16dc121ad.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f7674a9ef0daa6c21eab450f460211fdfc470682dc29ba88e3f589a6d79c8c4.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b09b81e79165d847c0a662cb7c36365fd435b00837e5b5dcd5cb5ed16dc121ad.png] Both the figures matches completely, so the pattern is correct.

Option 4) 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b69f488237f6d2f4f6a736e894c9f182763ded96d2463ea40b8283f6cbafc46.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f7674a9ef0daa6c21eab450f460211fdfc470682dc29ba88e3f589a6d79c8c4.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b09b81e79165d847c0a662cb7c36365fd435b00837e5b5dcd5cb5ed16dc121ad.png] Number of rings are less, so the pattern is incorrect.
